messages:
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands. Quick follow-up thread with clarifications and owners for the items leadership asked us to track. Will drop links and short action items below — please react with :white_check_mark: when you own something.

Alex Green: Appreciate it — can you confirm the rollout window for dynamic routing? Leadership mentioned 'early next week' but we need a schedule for SRE.

Maya Patel: Yes — plan is to start canary on Monday 09:00 PT, broader rollout Wed 14:00 PT if no regressions. Jamie, can you own the canary ticket and the smoke test checklist?

Jamie Lin: I can take it. I'll create the ticket in ✨incidents/rollouts✨ and link the checklist. Tentative ETA for ticket: EOD today. :+1:

Lorenzo Ruiz: Two quick asks from infra: (1) exact SLO target we should enforce during canary, (2) what fallback policy to use if latency spikes.

Maya Patel: SLO: p95 tail latency <= 220ms and error rate < 0.5% for the canary group. Fallback: automatic routing to model-variant v1.9 (same-region) + alert to oncall. Added to the doc here: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/dynamic-routing-canary (internal link)

Alex Green: Thanks — can we add a cheap smoke check command for the runbook so oncall can run manually?

Maya Patel: Good call. Adding snippet to the runbook now. Use this to sanity-check the model endpoint: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test: ping"}' | jq '.status'
```
If status == "ok" and latency < 500ms proceed.

Jamie Lin: Ticket created: https://redwood-internal.company/tickets/RI-2345 — added checklist, smoke commands, expected metrics, and owner assignment to me. I'll post progress updates in #eng-oncall during canary.

SRE Oncall: Noted — I'll add a Datadog dashboard (canary view) and an automated monitor for p95 + error rate. Ping me if you want a temporary lower threshold for the first 2 hours.

Maya Patel: Please do set a temporary alert threshold: p95 >= 180ms OR error_rate >= 0.3% to trigger a Slack alert to @SRE Oncall and @ops-bot. ops-bot, please schedule the automated rollback hook if thresholds are hit.

ops-bot: Scheduled automated rollback hook "dyn-route-canary-rollback" for Monday 09:00 PT with trigger: p95 >= 180ms OR error_rate >= 0.3%. Will post a confirmation once integrated.

Lorenzo Ruiz: One more dependency: network team asked for a small IP allowlist to permit canary traffic from the new routing tier. Who should I coordinate with?

Alex Green: Loop in @Networking (channel) and cc me. I can help with the CIDR ranges; will add them to the ticket.

Maya Patel: Action items summary (copied into ticket RI-2345):
- Jamie: create and own canary ticket + run checklist (done)
- Alex: coordinate network allowlist + provide CIDRs
- SRE Oncall: add Datadog canary dashboard and monitors
- ops-bot: rollback hook scheduled
- Maya: confirm SLA targets and update runbook (done)

Jamie Lin: I'll post a pre-canary checklist reminder in #eng-oncall on Monday 07:30 PT. If anyone wants to add items to the checklist, drop them here.

Alex Green: One ask from leadership: please include a short blurb (~2 lines) for the execs summarizing risk & rollback plan in the ticket. I'll take that.

Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll add expected cost delta for the week and the exec blurb.

Lorenzo Ruiz: Thanks all — will start reach-out to Networking now.

Maya Patel: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything changes I'll update this thread and the ticket. :sparkles:
